segments.name: Light-control technology
segments.description: Develops and licenses patented SPD-Smart suspended particle device light-control technology to licensees serving aerospace, architectural, automotive, marine and display markets.
segments.evidence: Research Frontiers operates in a single business segment which is engaged in the development and marketing of technology and devices to control the flow of light (see Note 1 to the Consolidated Financial Statements).

revenueModel.text: The Company generates revenue primarily through license fees and royalties paid by licensees of its SPD light-control technology.
